query: SELECT (SELECT state FROM central.step_attempts WHERE id = $1) AS "attempt!", (SELECT state FROM central.steps WHERE id = $2) AS "step!", (SELECT status FROM central.tasks WHERE id = $3) AS "task!", (SELECT waiting_reason FROM central.tasks WHERE id = $3) AS "waiting!", (SELECT status FROM central.runs WHERE id = $4) AS "run!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.events WHERE workspace_id = $5 AND kind = 'execution.recovery.reconciliation_required') AS "evidence!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.outbox WHERE workspace_id = $5 AND catalog_type = 'execution.reconciliation.required') AS "outbox!"
